title: Personal Loans Late Fees: Share After a Completed Term Extension Modification
content:
## Rule

A late-fee modification share applies to a Personal Loans loan whose Term Extension Modification was completed: completion fewer than 36 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the late fee's assessment date gives 0.9; completion 36 to 59 whole months before gives 0.95; a loan with neither gives no late-fee share.

The modification is the loan's Term Extension Modification under the Hardship Assistance Programs, in completed status; its completion date is the closing date on that plan's record.

The share multiplies the late-fee figure while it is still unrounded, before the late fee is held to no more than the unpaid portion of the installment and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Completed Term Extension Modification on the loan | Whole months from completion to the assessment date | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | fewer than 36 | 0.9 |
| yes | 36 to 59 | 0.95 |
| yes | 60 or more | no share |
| none completed (requested, active, broken, cancelled or none) | - | no share |

## Cases (hypothetical, assessment on 10 March)

- Completed on 11 March three years before: 35 whole months: 0.9.
- Completed on 10 March three years before: 36 whole months: 0.95.
- Completed on 10 March five years before: 60 whole months: no share.
